items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: But firstly, in Billy Fowler's band, Jack Johnson had the band. ... And Jack Johnson was working for this German man. And that's the last time I saw Jack Johnson.

ctx.x: How much were they paying at that time?

Well, we were making $50.00. You know, that was good. Some of them big fellows, they were making $150.00, like Fletcher was paying $150.00 then, you know. These cats (inaudible). But we were supposed to go in there and Wall Street crashed. I just remember Wall Street crashing and everything went to pot. Everything, big bands, music was cut out, and at that time there were speakeasies and all these things, too. So it was very, very, very difficult. Very difficult. Then I got a job working with this man, Cliff…
